description: This risk arises when an agent selects an inappropriate tool or applies a tool incorrectly for a given task or action. As a result, the agent may produce erroneous outcomes, fail to complete the task effectively, or trigger unintended side effects due to misuse of tool capabilities.

controls.statement: Provide comprehensive descriptions for each tool including intended use, required inputs, and potential outputs
Require explicit human confirmation before executing high-impact or irreversible tool actions
Log all tool selection decisions and invocations with comprehensive metadata
